program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff-pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # diff-pair L (gain, flicker area)
    "Itail": (8e-6, 5e-6, 12e-6),
    "I7":    (30e-6, 18e-6, 36e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmid7": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # mirror / second-stage pfet gm/Id (shared -> low offset)
    "L7":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # mirror / second-stage pfet L (shared)
    "Lb":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # nfet current-source L
    "Cc":    (0.8e-12, 0.4e-12, 1.5e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # Rz scaling around zero-on-p2 value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]

    # NMOS bias: diode + tail + second-stage sink (same L, same gm/Id)
    gmb = 10.0
    mb = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], Iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], It, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.5)
    # PMOS mirror load (diode) and second-stage device, same density
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], It / 2, vds=1.1)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=m3.vgs)

    # compensation: zero on p2
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 / m7.gm) * (1.0 + (CL + C1) / Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # vinp drives node n1 -> non-inverting through the inverting 2nd stage
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * CL + Cc * (C1 + CL)) / (2 * PI)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    mirror_p = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (p2 * 3))) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3)) \
         - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / mirror_p))
    sr = min(It / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    power = VDD * (Iref + It + I7)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    nth = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * kT * (2.0 / 3) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    settle = 0.5 / sr + 4.6 / (2 * PI * gbw) if sr > 0 else 1.0
    ro_t = 1.0 / max(mt.gds, 1e-15)
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m1.gm * ro_t
    swing = (VDD - m7.vdsat - 0.05) - (m8.vdsat + 0.05)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "slew": sr, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": 3 * nth, "settle": settle, "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
               "psrr_db": db(A0) + 20, "swing": swing, "vos": 0.0}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller (NMOS input, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS output, Rz-Cc)
